capabilities: Add full-height columns beside existing sidebar content
Split a sidebar tab row into side-by-side groups
Add a full-width bottom row spanning sidebar columns
Collapse columns into an expand rail and reopen them
Back up the workspace layout and restore from snapshots
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only; Windows verified on Obsidian 1.14.4, macOS and Linux unverified. Install into a disposable test vault first; no telemetry or network requests.
intentEvidence: This reintroduces a deliberately disabled, unsupported layout arrangement.
motivation: The author reintroduces a deliberately disabled layout arrangement that became reachable when central workspace tab-management code was reused for sidebar tabs.
problem: Obsidian removed the sidebar "Split right" action in 1.6.4, so sidebar panels can no longer be arranged in multiple columns.
summary: Experimental plugin that adds native side-by-side columns, row splits and full-width rows to Obsidian's left and right sidebars on desktop.
